SELECT "id", "po_number", "supplier_id", "status", "total_amount", "currency", "issued_at", "expected_date", "buyer_id", "department", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at", count(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM {{table:purchase_orders}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("po_number"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("department"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("notes"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($7::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5::text = 'po_number' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "po_number" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'po_number' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "po_number" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'total_amount' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "total_amount" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'total_amount' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "total_amount" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'issued_at' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "issued_at" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'issued_at' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "issued_at" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'expected_date' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "expected_date" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'expected_date' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "expected_date" END DESC, id DESC
LIMIT $4::int OFFSET ((($3::int - 1) * $4::int))

SELECT "id", "po_number", "supplier_id", "status", "total_amount", "currency", "issued_at", "expected_date", "buyer_id", "department", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
FROM {{table:purchase_orders}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("po_number"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("department"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("notes"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($3::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($3::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 5000

SELECT "id", "po_number", "supplier_id", "status", "total_amount", "currency", "issued_at", "expected_date", "buyer_id", "department", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:purchase_orders}} WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO {{table:purchase_orders}} ("po_number", "supplier_id", "status", "total_amount", "currency", "issued_at", "expected_date", "buyer_id", "department", "notes", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::int, $3::text, $4::numeric, $5::text, $6::timestamptz, $7::date, $8::int, $9::text, $10::text, now(), now())
RETURNING "id", "po_number", "supplier_id", "status", "total_amount", "currency", "issued_at", "expected_date", "buyer_id", "department", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"

UPDATE {{table:purchase_orders}}
SET "po_number" = $2::text, "supplier_id" = $3::int, "status" = $4::text, "total_amount" = $5::numeric, "currency" = $6::text, "issued_at" = $7::timestamptz, "expected_date" = $8::date, "buyer_id" = $9::int, "department" = $10::text, "notes" = $11::text, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL
RETURNING "id", "po_number", "supplier_id", "status", "total_amount", "currency", "issued_at", "expected_date", "buyer_id", "department", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
UPDATE {{table:purchase_orders}} SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:purchase_orders}} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING id
SELECT id, "po_number"::text AS label FROM {{table:purchase_orders}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY "po_number" LIMIT 500
UPDATE {{table:purchase_orders}} SET "status" = $2::text, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "status"
UPDATE {{table:purchase_orders}} SET "buyer_id" = $2::int, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "buyer_id"

SELECT count(*)::int AS total, coalesce(sum("total_amount"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS total_value, coalesce(avg("total_amount"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS average_value, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'open')::int AS status_open, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'partially_received')::int AS status_partially_received, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'fully_received')::int AS status_fully_received, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'closed')::int AS status_closed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'cancelled')::int AS status_cancelled
FROM {{table:purchase_orders}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF($1::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($1::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at)::date AS day, count(*)::int AS count, coalesce(sum("total_amount"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS total
FROM {{table:purchase_orders}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= coalesce(NULLIF($1::text, '')::date, now() - interval '90 days')
  AND created_at < (coalesce(NULLIF($2::text, '')::date, now()::date) + interval '1 day')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT "status" AS status, count(*)::int AS count FROM {{table:purchase_orders}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF($1::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($1::text, '')::date) AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date + interval '1 day')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT "id", "po_number", "supplier_id", "status", "total_amount", "currency", "issued_at", "expected_date", "buyer_id", "department", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:purchase_orders}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND "issued_at" IS NOT NULL
  AND "issued_at" < now() - ($1::int || ' days')::interval
  AND "status" NOT IN ('closed', 'cancelled')
ORDER BY "issued_at" ASC LIMIT 100
